title: Around Marshall (0200907)
author: NASA Marshall Space Flight Center
description: Students from across the United States and as far away as Puerto Rico and South America came to Huntsville, Alabama for the 9th annual Great Moonbuggy Race at the U.S. Space Rocket Center.
